question.text:
Consider the statement p: If slope of a straight line is 1 then it is equally inclined to both the axes.

Then, the contrapositive of the statement p is

options.text: If a straight line is equally inclined to both the axes then its slope is <math><mn>1</mn></math>
If a straight line is equally inclined to both the axes then its slope is not <math><mn>1</mn></math>
If a straight line is not equally inclined to both the axes then its slope is not <math><mn>1</mn></math>
If a straight line is not equally inclined to both the axes then its slope is <math><mn>1</mn></math>

solution.text:
Contrapositive of statement “if p then q” is “if ~q then ~p.
Hence contrapositive is
"If a straight line is not equally inclined to both the axes then its slope is not 1"
